facts_raw.Focus: AI / deep tech / health / media / engineering
facts_raw.Funding Trigger: At acceptance / after standard legal checks; typically wired within ~3 weeks
facts_raw.Equity / Economic Terms: $200K uncapped MFN SAFE + $20K Post-Money CEA for 5% common; side letter includes pro-rata and other rights
facts_raw.Company Required at Application: No; company must be incorporated in a Techstars-acceptable US/foreign equivalent structure before investment closes
facts_raw.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Requires a USC-affiliated founding member; founders affiliated with Keck Medicine USC / CHLA also eligible
facts_raw.Official / Must-Have Requirements: 至少一名创始成员必须与 USC 相关：student/alumni/faculty/staff，或 Keck Medicine / CHLA 关联。 Accepted founders are expected to dedicate full exclusivity to the startup during the accelerator. Techstars invests only after incorporation/ownership/IP/bank-account checks.
facts_raw.On-site / Attendance: Program takes place at USC University Park Campus; office space provided for duration.
facts_raw.International Founder: Possible if USC affiliation and US participation feasible
facts_raw.Visa / Relocation: 未见项目统一签证赞助。
facts_raw.Application Materials: Techstars 标准申请：founder profile、公司、demo video、pitch deck、team video、traction、revenue/funding 等。
facts_raw.Public Contact Route: Techstars Program page / Get in Touch；Senior Program Manager Allison Kitain。
facts_raw.Foundshore Best Fit: 硬件 / 机器人 / DeepTech；MedTech / Health / Bio；AI / AI-native；阶段以 Pre-seed–seed 为主。
facts_raw.Foundshore Not Fit: 已进入成熟增长期、仅寻求销售渠道而非创业加速的公司；缺少核心技术/IP、仅做轻量同质化应用或贸易型项目；纯线下传统业务、缺乏可规模化技术产品
facts_raw.Notes: Requires USC affiliation on founding team.

facts.Focus: AI / deep tech / health / media / engineering
facts.Funding Trigger: At acceptance / after standard legal checks; typically wired within ~3 weeks
facts.Equity / Economic Terms: $200K uncapped MFN SAFE + $20K Post-Money CEA for 5% common; side letter includes pro-rata and other rights
facts.Company Required at Application: No; company must be incorporated in a Techstars-acceptable US/foreign equivalent structure before investment closes
facts.Geography / Affiliation Restriction: Requires a USC-affiliated founding member; founders affiliated with Keck Medicine USC / CHLA also eligible
facts.Official / Must-Have Requirements: At least one founding member must be connected to USC as a student, alumnus, faculty or staff member, or to Keck Medicine or CHLA. Accepted founders work exclusively on the startup. Techstars invests after incorporation, ownership, IP and bank-account checks.
facts.Strong-to-Have: Pre-seed and seed companies in AI, health, deeptech, media and engineering, with resilient founders, clarity, traction and commitment.
facts.On-site / Attendance: Program takes place at USC University Park Campus; office space provided for duration.
facts.International Founder: Possible if USC affiliation and US participation feasible
facts.Visa / Relocation: No standard program visa sponsorship published.
facts.Application Materials: Techstars application: founder profile, company information, demo video, pitch deck, team video, traction, revenue and funding.
facts.Public Contact Route: Techstars Program page / Get in Touch；Senior Program Manager Allison Kitain。
facts.Foundshore Best Fit: Hardware / Robotics / DeepTech; MedTech / Health / Bio; AI / AI-native; primarily at the Pre-seed–seed stage.
facts.Foundshore Not Fit: Mature growth companies seeking sales channels rather than acceleration; Projects without core technology or IP, including undifferentiated apps and trading businesses; Traditional offline businesses without a scalable technology product
facts.Notes: Requires USC affiliation on founding team.
